title: Cell start template
statement: Let $k,L$ be natural numbers, let $M$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $t_0$ be a Boolean, and let $\tau$ be a natural number. The cell-start label is the template for cell $\tau$ with bit $t_0$ and phase $0$ when $\tau<k$; when $\tau\ge k$, it is the input template with bit $t_0$ and phase $p_0$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite Boolean Turing machine M
